description: Engine §10 rejects incompatible union operands in `"a" ∪ ($x.without-elision.tokens-after-first)`.
grammar:
%const $S "ab"
%const $Q ("a" "b")
%const $TAG (A B)
%const $P #A
%const $E "a" ∖ "a"
%rule text $x:unit B %conditions "a" ∪ ($x.without-elision.tokens-after-first)
%rule unit A
%rule family unit
%rule want A
